{{Quote|What's his name?''"<br />"''Jaalib Brandl.''"<br />"''I want to meet him. You speak Iscerian, don't you? Talk to the owner.''"<br />"''I'll see what I can do.|Fable Astin, to Deke Holman|<ref name="Journal8" />}}
'''Iscerian''' was a [[Language/Legends|language]] spoken on [[Iscera]],<ref name="Journal8" /> a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CSWE Iscera">{{CSWECite|II|118|Iscera}}</ref> in the [[Dalchon sector/Legends|Dalchon sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Iscera system/Legends|Iscera system]]</ref> [[Deke Holman]], a [[Socorran]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and a former [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] and [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]], also spoke it.<ref name="Journal8" />

In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="0 ABY">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of {{JournalCite|8|Uhl Eharl Khoehng (short story)}} to [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].</ref> Holman and his [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officer]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Fable Astin/Legends|Fable Astin]], attended a performance of the play ''[[For the Want of an Empire]]'' at a [[Iscera theater|theater]] on Iscera. During the performance, Astin became intrigued by the lead [[Actor/Legends|actor]], the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Jaalib Brandl]], and his [[Sword/Legends|swordfighting]] skills. Recalling Holman's knowledge of Iscerian, she then asked that he arrange with the theater's owner a meeting with Brandl for her&mdash;a request that the Socorran met with grumbling under his breath. Nevertheless, Holman successfully managed to locate Brandl after the spectacle's end and thereby let Astin meet him.<ref name="Journal8" />

==Behind the scenes==
Iscerian was mentioned in the short story "[[Uhl Eharl Khoehng (short story)|Uhl Eharl Khoehng]]," which was written by [[Patricia A. Jackson]] and published in the [[November]] [[1995]] [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 8|eighth issue]] of [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' magazine.<ref name="Journal8" />
